text: 忘记登录密码时，在账户登录页选择找回密码，使用邮箱验证码重置口令。
连续输错口令会冻结账号十五分钟。管理员可在账号列表中手动解锁。
更换手机前应保存双重验证的恢复码。手机遗失时使用备用恢复码继续登录。
邀请成员需要在工作区填写收件人邮箱，邀请链接四十八小时内有效。
在设备管理页可以强制退出全部已登录终端。签出所有会话后需重新认证。
Rotate a service API key by issuing a replacement, switching clients, then revoking the old credential.
The rate limit for API requests is per project. After HTTP 429, respect Retry-After before retrying.
When a signed access token expires, obtain a new token using the refresh credential.
A service credential belongs to one project. Check the target knowledge grant when an endpoint returns 404.
Audit logs record the service account, resource, action and time. Administrators can export the logs.
包裹交给快递前可在订单页修改收货地址。已发货时联系承运商办理改派。
物流轨迹超过七十二小时未更新，可通过订单编号提交延误工单。
快递箱破损或商品碎裂时，保留外包装照片并申请运输理赔。
签收后七天内可发起无理由退货。请保留包装并在订单页提交退回申请。
退回的货物验收后，退款将在五个工作日内原路返还到付款账户。
申请增值税发票需要公司抬头和纳税人识别号，开票资料可在账单中心填写。
关闭自动续费后，订阅在本期结束时到期。已支付的本期费用照常计费。
Update the billing card in payment settings. An unpaid invoice can be retried after the new card is verified.
Download itemized billing records by selecting a date range and exporting the usage report as CSV.
扫描版 PDF 缺少文字层，先执行 OCR 文字识别再导入知识库，以便检索图片中的字。
长文档应按标题切成多个分段。缩短分段并设置重叠长度可以保留段落间上下文。
知识库更换向量模型后需要重建索引。在文档页面查看向量化任务状态，失败任务可重新提交。
Each retrieval hit identifies its document and paragraph. Use these references to display a citation beside the answer.
标签可按产品线标记文档。编辑知识库标签字典后，将对应标签关联到文档。
知识内容可以导出为 JSON 备份。在目标知识库导入备份会生成新的文档和分段标识。
Keyword search matches indexed terms. Add a domain term when tokenization splits a brand or part number incorrectly.
Embedding search ranks passages by cosine distance. The query vector must match the index dimension.
Reconnect an interrupted event stream with the last received event ID. The server replays subsequent run events.
Retry a failed workflow step after its external dependency recovers. Record each attempt separately.
Set a maximum iteration count on the loop node. Execution stops when the exit condition is true.
When a model endpoint times out, inspect provider latency and the configured request deadline.
Cancel an active run to stop scheduling further steps. A cancelled run retains its execution history.
NX-210 网关使用圆口 12V 电源，长按机身蓝键八秒可恢复出厂设置。
NX-201 网关通过 USB-C 取电。恢复出厂设置需要按住底部复位键三秒。
NX-210-Pro industrial gateway uses a terminal block. Factory reset requires holding the recessed switch for fifteen seconds.
The R-45 sensor uses a CR2032 coin cell. Open the back cover to replace its battery.
The R-54 sensor uses two AAA batteries. Replace the pair together and confirm polarity.
AJ-7 打印机显示 E-134 表示进纸辊卡纸，关闭电源后取出纸张。
AJ-8 打印机显示 E-143 表示墨盒仓盖未关闭，重新盖紧后继续打印。
For Bridge firmware v2.1.2, disable roaming before upgrading. Restore roaming after the device restarts.
Bridge firmware v2.2.1 adds Wi-Fi roaming support. Keep roaming enabled when applying the patch.
Status LED blinking amber means the gateway lost its upstream connection. Check its Ethernet cable.
Database backups run nightly. To restore a snapshot, select the desired timestamp and verify checksums.
When a webhook delivery fails, inspect HTTP response codes and confirm the receiving URL.
通过代理访问外部模型时配置 HTTP 代理地址。内网模型可加入代理排除列表。
证书过期会导致 TLS 握手失败。更新证书链并重启入口服务后重试。
如果域名无法解析，先检查 DNS 服务器，再刷新本机域名解析缓存。
优惠券在结算页面使用。订单完成后无法补用折扣码。
